name: Michele Morrow
incumbencyStatus: first-time Senate candidate (2024 NC Superintendent of Public Instruction nominee, lost general)

priorRoles: 2024 Republican nominee for NC Superintendent of Public Instruction (lost general election to Mo Green by ~4 points)
biography.background: Former registered nurse turned conservative activist and homeschool educator. Won the 2024 Republican primary for NC Superintendent of Public Instruction over incumbent Catherine Truitt, then lost the general election. Currently polling at 1.6-4% against Trump-endorsed Michael Whatley in the March 3, 2026 NC GOP Senate primary. Raised only $10,720 as of Feb 11, 2026 with ~$5,248 cash on hand.

statedPositions.quote: Supports private vouchers and school competition model
statedPositions.notes: Core issue from Superintendent campaign. Supports school vouchers, parental choice, opposes public school 'monopoly.' Launched lobbying group for school choice after 2024 loss.

statedPositions.quote: Replace ACA with market-based solutions and health savings accounts
statedPositions.notes: Market-based healthcare framing. HSAs as primary mechanism.

statedPositions.quote: Medical freedom activist. Anti-vaccine mandate. Referred to COVID vaccine as 'population control'
statedPositions.notes: Extensive social media record of anti-vaccine positions. Called COVID vaccine 'population control.' Central to her activist identity.

statedPositions.quote: Broad 2A support, armed teachers, no stated support for any regulation
statedPositions.notes: Supports arming teachers. No gun safety or regulation positions found.

statedPositions.quote: Mass deportation, self-deportation programs, hardline border enforcement
statedPositions.notes: Hardline immigration enforcement is a central campaign issue.
Government waste reduction messaging. No support for expanding safety net programs.
